name: matrix-decode
title: Matrix Decode
description: A deterministic matrix-style decode: one monospace cell per character staggers in and resolves the target word. Monospace on purpose: a decode is a code look, and code stays monospace (brand: Bebas Neue and Montserrat for words, monospace for code). Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="matrix-decode": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Target text
variables.description: Word the scramble resolves into. One scrambling cell per character, up to 32.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Type size of the cells in pixels. A row wider than its space shrinks to fit, never under 28 px, then wraps.
